why: ACTION AT A DISTANCE is Edgar's weakest identity axis (noncombat damage 4.32/game). Ingris Stingerquill (FRA) pings each opponent for every attacker, so it scales with the 8.04 bodies eminence mints rather than adding a flat payoff. Objective is TOTAL life removed, not noncombat damage alone: entry-v1 raised noncombat 4.32 -> 10.31 and still lost ground on the total. BLOCKED on Forge: the 2026-08-08 build has no Ingris script, so simulate refuses until Forge ships FRA.
